annotations.title: Ask for changes to an edit

description: Sends an edit in review back to the worker with a note on what to change. The note is added to the plan and shows in edit_job_get's steps.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

worker.description: The leasing worker's name; checked for a graphic job

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
